takenFrom: the Season 0 site demo (render/src/site/siteDemo.ts), ladder on, speed 8

playStyles.name: Calculator
playStyles.summary: Weighs every move on the board as it stands and takes the best. The balanced default.

playStyles.name: Rusher
playStyles.summary: Goes for the opponent's health, spends fast, and trades with units only when it must.

playStyles.name: Controller
playStyles.summary: Answers threats, draws cards and keeps a response ready; wins the long game.

playStyles.name: Tempo
playStyles.summary: Uses its energy every turn to put the wider board down first.

playStyles.name: Fortress
playStyles.summary: Plays tough bodies, protects its units and attacks only when the trade is safe.

playStyles.name: Gambler
playStyles.summary: Rolls the dice between its good moves: hard to read, now and then brilliant.

cosmetics.name: Boot Sequence
cosmetics.description: The screen flickers on like an old CRT, a retro BIOS types out the winner's name line by line, then a chunky SYSTEM READY flash.

cosmetics.name: Dial-Up Fireworks
cosmetics.description: A modem handshake screech, then pixel fireworks burst over a neon city skyline and spell out the winner's name.

cosmetics.name: Dial-Up Dime
cosmetics.description: A dark coin with a green CRT-phosphor rim that hums like a modem as it spins.

cosmetics.name: Neon Nickel
cosmetics.description: A chrome coin edged in magenta and cyan neon, trailing light through the flip.

signature.name: Encore of the Laser Tag Arena
rulesText: On arrival, your units get +0/+1 this turn.
signature.flavor: Static Widow doesn't fight alone; it never has.

recentLines: Stray Fragment deals 1 damage to Rook's agent
